_meta.purpose: Map our bundled catalog key (provider/model_name) to the LiteLLM model_prices_and_context_window.json key used by the parity test.
_meta.null_means: No direct LiteLLM equivalent at the pinned SHA. Parity test skips with a warning. Reason documented per entry where useful.

_skip_reasons.openai/o1-mini: LiteLLM main has no Anthropic-style o1-mini key; the only 'o1-mini' entries are under the Azure namespace. The OpenAI-direct o1-mini API still exists, so our bundled rate is correct; parity check skipped.
_skip_reasons.anthropic/claude-3-5-sonnet-latest: LiteLLM main dropped the Anthropic-direct Claude 3.5 family; only Bedrock and other-provider namespace variants remain. The -latest alias points to the 20241022 dated snapshot in practice; parity check skipped.
_skip_reasons.anthropic/claude-3-5-haiku-latest: Same as claude-3-5-sonnet-latest; LiteLLM has dropped the Anthropic-direct 3.5 family.
_skip_reasons.google_genai/gemini-1.5-pro: Removed from LiteLLM main. Bundled rate kept for callers that still hit the v1 API before the deprecation date.
_skip_reasons.google_genai/gemini-1.5-flash: LiteLLM main only carries the embedding model now (gemini/gemini-1.5-flash with mode=embedding and output_cost_per_token=0). The chat model is gone; parity check skipped.
_skip_reasons.groq/llama-3.1-70b-versatile: Removed from Groq's public pricing page. Rate kept for backward compat with the still-callable model; parity check skipped.
